questions.question: Why did the king of Babylon send letters and a gift to King Hezekiah of Judah?

answers.text: He heard Hezekiah had been ill
Hezekiah had sent him gifts first
He wanted to start trading with Judah

questions.question: The prophet Isaiah told King Hezekiah that everything in his palace would one day be carried off to which land?
The LORD told King Hezekiah through Isaiah that some of the treasures in his palace would be left behind. True or false?
Isaiah told King Hezekiah that his treasures and descendants would be taken away. Why did Hezekiah call the LORD's word good?

answers.text: He thought there would be peace in his lifetime
He believed the LORD would change His mind
He expected his sons to win the treasure back
